transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm just here because I feel... worn down. Almost all the time, really. 

Even if I get a full night's sleep, it doesn't seem to make much of a difference. By the time I get through work and try to deal with the house clutter, I just... I have very little left for anything else. So, I figured I should come in.
Do you often feel sad or empty?

I suppose... yeah. Most days, there’s just this... low, gray mood running in the background. I mean, I still go into the lab and talk to people fine. I just... I don't really feel light or excited about things anymore. Even stuff I used to like... baking, or taking the telescope out... I just don't really care to do them the way I used to.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like, or has that changed?
Um... yeah, like I just mentioned, it's changed. I just don't really have the interest for them right now.
Do you still get pleasure from things like eating or being around loved ones?
I mean... eating is fine, I guess. It's just food. And... I don't know, being around people is okay, but it's mostly just tiring. I don't really feel much one way or the other.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
No, not really. I mean... I don't think so. Just the normal amount, I guess.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?
Um... no, not really. I can't think of anything that stands out. I just... I don't know, nothing really comes to mind right now.
Do you find yourself moving or speaking more slowly than you used to, or feeling restless and fidgety?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... it's been a while. I guess... maybe a little over two years? It kind of started shortly after we moved into the older house. Just... yeah, about two years.
Have you lost any weight recently?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed any change. My weight has pretty much stayed the same.
Do you often feel worthless?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I don't think so.
Have you had any periods in the last two years where your symptoms were significantly worse for a while?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's just been... pretty much the same the whole time. Nothing really stands out.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
No... I haven't. Nothing like that.
Have you had any episodes where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of months?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. It just... kind of stays the same.
Do you think your low mood and loss of interest in activities are mild, moderate, or severe?
Um... I guess... probably mild. It's not severe or anything.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't really think so. I just kind of do the same things I always do, I guess.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that would normally bring you happiness?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I still do things... it's just normal, I guess.
Do you feel like activities that normally would be enjoyable are now just going through the motions without any real pleasure?
Um... no. I don't really feel that way. I mean, I still like doing my usual stuff. It doesn't feel like I'm just faking it or anything... it's just normal.
Has your current episode of feeling worn down and disinterested in activities lasted for more than two years?
Um... yeah, I suppose so. It's just kind of been this way since shortly after we moved into the older house. So... a little over two years ago, I guess.
Would you describe your current feelings of being worn down and disinterested as mildly, moderately, or severely impacting your daily life?

Um... I guess mildly. I mean, I'm still getting my lab work done and everything. It's just... some things take a bit longer, like grant drafts or making decisions on routine projects. And at home... I don't really do the things I used to. Like baking, or working on my bonsai trees, or using my telescope. I just... don't keep up with them anymore.
Do you feel like you're unable to find pleasure in things that you used to enjoy?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I still enjoy things when I actually do them. I just... don't do them as much right now.
